faq.title: Saray tepet ya mabalot ya lumalsa sakbay ya mangipo.
faq.description: No agni nasungbatan dia so tepet yo, makatulong so sakey ya konsultasyon pian matakda so kaukolan yo.
faq.0.question: Nanon ya serbisyo so malyaring gawaen na Nocoding?
faq.0.answer: Gagawaen mi saray personal ya portfolio odino CV website, landing page odino company profile, sistema na impormasyon tan operasyon, tan automation na proseso na negosyo.
faq.1.question: Pigan ya agew so pangagawa?
faq.1.answer: Say personal ya portfolio, CV, odino simpli ya landing page et mabalot ya 1-3 agew na gawa kayari na pakahanda na materyales. Saray mas baleg ya proyekto et nasasalalay ed kaukolan ya feature, integrasyon, tan bilis na puna.
faq.2.question: Malyari kasi ya i-customize so disenyo tan feature?
faq.2.answer: Wala. Say disenyo, istruktura na pahina, feature, tan daloy na gawa et malyari ya hulmaen ed kaukolan yo. Say disenyo et sisiyasaten ya agpapawil sakbay ya mangipo so pangagawa.
faq.3.question: Nanon so kaabay ed presyo?
faq.3.answer: Say presyo et saklaw na pangagawa ed pinagkasunduan ya pakete tan saklaw. Say Maksil ya pakete et walay libre ya panagpanatili tan domain ed 1 taon, ya say Baleg ya pakete et walay libre ya panagpanatili tan hosting ed 1 taon.
